Validate the internal consistency of a peak_params object

Source: R/peak_catalog.R
validate_peak_params.Rd

Checks the invariants every function that consumes peak_params relies on:

  • all per-peak vectors (every field ending in _raw, e.g. rt_loc_raw, rt_seconds_raw, sample_idx_raw) have one common length;

  • rt_seconds_raw and cv_volts_raw are present together or not at all;

  • sample_idx_raw, if present, is integer-valued with no NA and lies in 1..n_samples;

  • per-sample fields (sample_names, sample_cohort, n_peaks$values, the per-sample vectors in alignment) have length n_samples, and time_ranges / cv_ranges have n_samples rows;

  • rt_loc$values / cv_loc$values, if present, match the per-peak length.

Called at the top of build_peak_catalog() and at the end of every function that returns a transformed peak_params. Useful on saved objects too: a physical-mode peak_params written by subset_peak_params() before this check existed fails here (its rt_seconds_raw / cv_volts_raw were left unsubset).

Usage

validate_peak_params(peak_params, context = "peak_params")

Arguments

peak_params

A peak_params list.

context

Label used in error messages.

Value

peak_params, invisibly. Errors on the first violation.
